test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 07 March 2023)
subject: english
question: What is the estimate of rice export in the year 2021-22?

options.text: It will remain the same as the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.
It may fall below the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.
It will exceed the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.
It will not pass beyond the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **It will exceed the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's have a look at the **last line** of the** third paragraph**:

 
 
• **"It is anticipated that India’s rice exports in 2021-22 would likely surpass the record feet of 17.72 MT achieved in 2020-21."**
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the estimate of rice export in the year 2021-22 will exceed the 17.72 MT rice export achieved in 2020-21.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
